    else:
        print('ok   %s' % name)


INVALID = {"status": "invalid"}
NOT_LOADED = {"status": "error", "code": "NOT_LOADED", "rev": 0}

# --- schema violations before any load -----------------------------------

]

    '{"op":"audit","at":[0]}',

        expect('post %d %s' % (i, line[:44]), out[i], NOT_LOADED)
